'''Alexander Leonidovich Gintsburg''' ({{langx|ru|Александр Леонидович Гинцбург}}; born 10 November 1951) is a Soviet and Russian microbiologist. Since 1997, he has been the director of the [[Gamaleya Research Institute of Epidemiology and Microbiology]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Академику Гинцбургу Александру Леонидовичу - 65 лет! |url=http://www.ras.ru/news/shownews.aspx?id=5da8dc89-9718-4998-8402-cb6724ddce8b |website=www.ras.ru |publisher=[[Russian Academy of Sciences]] |accessdate=15 August 2020}}</ref> He is Jewish.<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.jpost.com/50-most-influential-jews/vying-for-vaccine-642120 | title=Three Jews on a mission to develop a coronavirus vaccine }}</ref>

In 2021 he was awarded the [[Fiddler on the Roof Award]] in the Science category.<ref>[https://fjc-fsu.org/once-again-fiddler-on-the-roof-awards-for-2021-presented-in-moscow/ Once Again: ‘Fiddler on the Roof’ Awards for 2021 Presented in Moscow], 7 December 2021</ref>
